entities.name: Meshuvel
entities.description: A human female planeswalker who taught the young Urza, then feared his eyes, tried to trap him in a time pit and fled.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker new to his powers whose eyes let him see the multiverse uniquely.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: Ancient people Meshuvel had never heard of.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane Urza wanted to return to.

events.summary: Meshuvel explains planeswalking to Urza and teaches him to change shape and comprehend thought without language.
events.quote: She taught him how to change his shape at will and to comprehend thought without the inconvenience of language.

events.summary: Meshuvel tries to snare Urza in a time pit, fails, and flees the plane.
events.quote: she tried to snare him in a time pit

events.summary: Urza does not follow Meshuvel, wanting to return to Dominaria.
events.quote: he was too caught by his desire to return to Dominaria and never followed her

relations.note: Taught him to shape-change and comprehend thought
relations.quote: She taught him how to change his shape at will

relations.note: Feared his eyes and tried to trap him
relations.quote: she feared them so much that she tried to snare him in a time pit
